messages:
Maya_CS: Hey @Anna_Concordia @Devon_Concordia — quick sync: we want to run a short integration check and a 5-min qualitative survey to capture early UX + blocker signals before the wider beta. Thurs or Fri this week? :wave:
Anna_Concordia: Thurs works for us, prefer morning (PST). Thanks for flagging.
Devon_Concordia: Morning ok. Also we hit one intermittent auth failure last night — token refresh? I can share logs.
onboarding-bot: Reminder: Concordia onboarding checklist: integration tests 3/5 passed, docs acked.
Tony_SE: Devon — can you paste the auth error trace here or DM me? Common issue is clock skew with the service account. If you have the error it's usually: `401 invalid_token` + `iat` mismatch.
Devon_Concordia: Pasting snippet: ```{"error":"invalid_token","msg":"token expired","time":"2026-03-19T03:12:08Z"}``` Not sure about clock skew.
Tony_SE: Thanks — two quick asks: (1) confirm server NTP is syncing, (2) try rotating the key once (we can do a safe rotate during the call).
Maya_CS: Agenda for the call: 1) quick walkthrough of integration state, 2) auth/logs triage if needed, 3) run 5-min qual survey, 4) agree follow-ups and enablement session timing. Can you both fill the short survey before the meeting? link: https://rwd.in/surveys/concordia-qa (should take <5m)
Anna_Concordia: Filled it. Left a note about docs gaps around webhook retries.
Olivia_PM: Noted re webhook retries — team is planning a small docs update and an example retry policy snippet this week. Maya, can we collect the specific webhook sample from Concordia to include?
Maya_CS: Yes — Anna, if you can drop a sample webhook payload or describe the retry window you'd like, we'll include it in the doc update.
Sam_AE: FYI — renewal for Concordia is slated in 6 months. This is low-risk now but we want to flag any repeat onboarding friction so we can adjust enablement credits earlier if needed.
Anna_Concordia: Will add webhook sample to the thread after the call.
Devon_Concordia: Also curious about expected token/sec throughput — we plan a pilot of 2k req/day to start and ramp. Any recommended batching/timeout config?
Tony_SE: For that volume, start with 50ms token timeout and enable batching w/ max_batch_size=8. Example config: ```batch: {enabled: true, max_batch_size: 8, timeout_ms: 50}``` We'll surface a tuning doc on the call.
Maya_CS: Great — I'll send calendar invite for Thu 10:00 PST and include Tony + Olivia. Please add any extra items or constraints here.
Anna_Concordia: 10:00 PST confirmed. Thanks team! :thumbsup:
Maya_CS: Thanks — final note: if anything blocks before Thu, DM me and we'll try a quick async triage.
Sam_AE: Adding a note to the account record about the docs + auth action items so CS + AE are aligned.
